Preserve local/SSH source, workspace, read-only, hash and line locators; preserve lock and stale-source rejection.

documentation.summary: Architecture and review explain current tab behavior, exact checks and unchanged production boundary.

cleanup.summary: Closed both own Safari test tabs, in-app component tab and temporary 59198 HTTP server. Original user tabs and certificate handoff candidate retained. No Docker rebuild or production restart.

release.summary: Prepare lightweight frontend source integration into main per user standing merge and simple-test direction; no version/Release or runtime deployment. Full profile and full-dependent release-check not run.

release_authorization: Retain user instructions 做完了合并到main and 这个简单测试即可，没改核心组件 for this small frontend repair; announced intended main integration in commentary. No paid calls, new Release or production replacement.
rollback: Revert this frontend source merge; no storage/schema or user-file mutation. Previous behavior used the map tab for file navigation.
handoff: Ready for source merge/push after docs checks. Native Safari tab-opening/reuse proven with synthetic viewer and real product module/wiring; actual full workbench and SSH content not retested. Production unchanged. Temporary UI tabs/server closed.
